failedSources.detail: armis.com/newsroom returns a 403 (Cloudflare/Akamai-style block) on three attempts; armis.com/sitemap.xml returns the same 403 block; no RSS/Atom feed found at /feed (429 on all three attempts, same as the sitemap pattern); no IR subdomain (wholly owned ServiceNow subsidiary since 2026-04-20, no separate IR site); no GlobeNewswire/PR Newswire/Business Wire search attempted this run (prior run, 2026-10-02, found only stale 2021 items); EDGAR full-text search for "Armis" with file_date 2026-10-03 to 2026-10-14 returns two hits, both an unrelated filer (Hercules Capital, Inc., 424B2 prospectus supplements) mentioning Armis only as a portfolio-company name, not Armis's own disclosure.

axonius.com/feed and axonius.com/sitemap.xml both return HTTP 429 (rate-limited/bot-challenge) on three attempts each; axonius.com/news was not separately retried after /feed failed; no IR subdomain (private company); EDGAR full-text search for "Axonius" with file_date 2026-10-03 to 2026-10-14 returns zero hits.

beyondtrust.com/resources/blog/press-release, /newsroom, and /sitemap.xml all return a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403) on three attempts each; no IR subdomain (PE-owned, private); EDGAR full-text search for "BeyondTrust" with file_date 2026-10-03 to 2026-10-14 returns two hits, both an unrelated filer (CISO Global, Inc. DEF 14A and ARS) mentioning BeyondTrust only as a vendor/competitor reference, not BeyondTrust's own disclosure.

bigid.com/blog/press-releases and /sitemap.xml both return a Cloudflare "Just a moment..." challenge (HTTP 403) on three attempts each; no IR subdomain (private company); EDGAR full-text search for "BigID" with file_date 2026-10-03 to 2026-10-14 returns zero hits.

cohesity.com/newsroom/ and /sitemap.xml both return an Akamai "Access Denied" response (HTTP 403) on three attempts each; no IR subdomain (private company); EDGAR full-text search for "Cohesity" with file_date 2026-10-03 to 2026-10-14 returns zero hits.

reliaquest.com/newsroom (= /news-and-press/) returns HTTP 200 with the correct page title ("News & Press - All") but the article list itself is client-rendered (React/Astro) with zero readable <article> or dated press-release elements in the raw HTML; no RSS/Atom feed found at /feed (returns HTTP 404).

trustwave.com/en-us/newsroom and /en-us/resources/news/ both return HTTP 404; trustwave.com/sitemap.xml returns HTTP 200 (8.3 MB) but contains zero URLs under any news or press path, consistent with Trustwave's own newsroom having been folded into its acquirer LevelBlue's site after the 2025-08-19 acquisition close; LevelBlue itself is not a tracked supplier so its site was not checked this run.

veracode.com/feed returns HTTP 200 with a well-formed but empty RSS channel (zero <item> entries); veracode.com/press-releases returns HTTP 404; veracode.com/sitemap.xml returns HTTP 200 but is a sitemap index with no dedicated news/press-release sub-sitemap (only page, resources, securities, directories, leadership, and resource-type sub-sitemaps).

witnessai.com/newsroom and /sitemap.xml both return HTTP 404 on three attempts each; witnessai.com/feed returns HTTP 200 but is a client-rendered HTML blog page, not RSS/Atom, with no readable dated press-release content; no IR subdomain (small private company); EDGAR full-text search for "WitnessAI" with file_date 2026-10-03 to 2026-10-14 returns zero hits.
